evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Quinton delivers the mandate with an energized, aphoristic framing — converting a policy into a rallying principle, high arousal and positive valence in the commitment.
Summary register is settled and satisfied — low arousal, positive valence of a decision landed and recorded without urgency or strain.
